en: The image features an ornate Gothic cathedral with a pointed roof, detailed tracery, and large stained glass windows. The prominent spire and richly decorated façade suggest important historical significance. The coloring of the image suggests it's an old, possibly hand-tinted postcard. There is text in the upper corners, with 'Kassa.' in the top left and 'Dóm.' in the top right.
